ideas.pitch: A mobile-first web app that combines localized financial literacy modules with automated micro-budgeting simulations, specifically targeting the digital and financial independence themes for high school and diploma students.
ideas.title: FinLit Agent: AI-Driven Micro-Savings & Budgeting Mentor for Young Women
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core themes of Digital Literacy and Financial Independence for Track 1, appealing heavily to judges looking for practical societal impact for young women.

ideas.pitch: An interactive legal companion tailored for female students and young professionals that simplifies complex legal rights, labor laws, and safety protocols into conversational, accessible regional languages.
ideas.title: HerRights AI: Legal Literacy and Rights Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the digital literacy and empowerment criteria of Track 1 by solving a critical real-world information asymmetry problem with accessible AI.

ideas.pitch: A dedicated collaboration and portfolio platform for engineering women featuring automated project verification, hackathon team-matching, and direct mentorship routing from senior female tech leaders.
ideas.title: CredHer: Engineering Portfolio & Peer Mentorship Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tailored specifically for the engineering track demographic, addressing the retention and networking gap in STEM fields through a functional community platform.

ideas.pitch: An engineering-focused health analytics platform that tracks physiological cycles alongside academic workload stress markers to provide personalized nutrition and wellness insights.
ideas.title: BioCycle & Wellness Tracker for Student Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous data tracking with health engineering, adapting proven nutrition-platform mechanics to women's specific physiological needs.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered resume parsing and mock-interview platform designed to bridge the gap between technical diplomas or engineering degrees and the corporate workforce.
ideas.title: SkillBridge: Automated Career Readiness and Resume Optimizer for Graduates
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear utility and career enablement, a metric that judging panels at innovation-focused ideathons consistently prioritize.
